Definition: from G1722 and G5092; valued (figuratively):--dear, more honourable, precious, in reputation.
BiblicalUsage: Entimos is what is valued — dear, precious, held in honour. Christ is the living stone, chosen of God and precious, in 1 Peter 2:4 and 2:6, the centurion's servant was dear unto him in Luke 7:2, and Paul tells the Philippians to hold such as Epaphroditus in reputation in Philippians 2:29.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe value is decided by the Valuer — men disallowed the Stone, but God chose Him and called Him precious. I hold that what God calls precious is precious, whatever men say, and I want to hold in reputation the people He honours.
